WITH ra AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON co.condition_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 80809
),
medmap AS (
  SELECT 'mtx' AS grp, 1305058 AS ancestor_id UNION ALL
  SELECT 'ssz', 964339 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'hcq', 1777087 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'bio', 1186087 UNION ALL SELECT 'bio',1119119 UNION ALL SELECT 'bio',1114375 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'bio',912263 UNION ALL SELECT 'bio',1151789 UNION ALL SELECT 'bio',19041065 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'bio',937368 UNION ALL SELECT 'bio',1314273 UNION ALL SELECT 'bio',1594587 UNION ALL SELECT 'bio',40171288
),
eras AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT de.person_id, mm.grp, de.drug_era_start_date AS start_date, de.drug_era_end_date AS end_date
  FROM omop.drug_era de
  JOIN medmap mm ON 1=1
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = mm.ancestor_id AND ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  JOIN ra ON ra.person_id = de.person_id
),
bio_mtx AS (
  SELECT m.person_id,
         CASE WHEN m.start_date > b.start_date THEN m.start_date ELSE b.start_date END AS index_date,
         CASE WHEN m.end_date < b.end_date THEN m.end_date ELSE b.end_date END AS overlap_end
  FROM eras m JOIN eras b ON m.person_id=b.person_id AND m.grp='mtx' AND b.grp='bio'
  WHERE m.start_date <= b.end_date AND b.start_date <= m.end_date
),
triple AS (
  SELECT m.person_id,
         (SELECT MAX(v) FROM (VALUES (m.start_date),(s.start_date),(h.start_date)) AS value(v)) AS index_date,
         (SELECT MIN(v) FROM (VALUES (m.end_date),(s.end_date),(h.end_date)) AS value(v)) AS overlap_end
  FROM eras m JOIN eras s ON m.person_id=s.person_id AND m.grp='mtx' AND s.grp='ssz'
              JOIN eras h ON m.person_id=h.person_id AND h.grp='hcq'
  WHERE m.start_date <= s.end_date AND s.start_date <= m.end_date
    AND m.start_date <= h.end_date AND h.start_date <= m.end_date
    AND s.start_date <= h.end_date AND h.start_date <= s.end_date
),
strategy AS (
  SELECT 'biologic + methotrexate' AS strategy, person_id, MIN(index_date) AS index_date FROM bio_mtx WHERE overlap_end >= index_date GROUP BY person_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'triple conventional DMARDs' AS strategy, t.person_id, MIN(t.index_date) AS index_date
  FROM triple t
  WHERE t.overlap_end >= t.index_date
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eras b WHERE b.person_id=t.person_id AND b.grp='bio' AND b.start_date <= t.index_date AND b.end_date >= t.index_date)
  GROUP BY t.person_id
),
flare AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id, co.condition_start_date AS flare_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON co.condition_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 4114444
)
SELECT strategy,
       COUNT(*) AS patients,
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM flare f WHERE f.person_id=s.person_id AND f.flare_date > s.index_date AND f.flare_date <= DATEADD(day,90,s.index_date)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flare_90d_patients,
       CAST(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM flare f WHERE f.person_id=s.person_id AND f.flare_date > s.index_date AND f.flare_date <= DATEADD(day,90,s.index_date)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS decimal(10,4)) AS flare_90d_proportion
FROM strategy s
GROUP BY strategy
ORDER BY strategy

),
strategy AS (
  SELECT 'biologic + methotrexate' AS strategy, person_id, MIN(index_date) AS index_date
  FROM bio_mtx0 WHERE overlap_end >= index_date GROUP BY person_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'triple conventional DMARDs' AS strategy, t.person_id, MIN(t.index_date) AS index_date
  FROM triple0 t
  WHERE t.overlap_end >= t.index_date
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eras b WHERE b.person_id=t.person_id AND b.grp='bio' AND b.start_date <= t.index_date AND b.end_date >= t.index_date)
  GROUP BY t.person_id
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT s.*
  FROM strategy s
  JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id = s.person_id AND op.observation_period_start_date <= s.index_date AND op.observation_period_end_date >= DATEADD(day,90,s.index_date)
),
flare AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id, co.condition_start_date AS flare_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON co.condition_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 4114444
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT e.strategy, e.person_id, e.index_date,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.flare_date > e.index_date AND f.flare_date <= DATEADD(day,90,e.index_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flare_90d
  FROM eligible e
  LEFT JOIN flare f ON f.person_id = e.person_id AND f.flare_date > e.index_date AND f.flare_date <= DATEADD(day,90,e.index_date)
  GROUP BY e.strategy, e.person_id, e.index_date
)
SELECT strategy,
       COUNT(*) AS patients,
       SUM(flare_90d) AS flare_90d_patients,
       CAST(1.0 * SUM(flare_90d) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS decimal(10,4)) AS flare_90d_proportion
FROM flagged
GROUP BY strategy
ORDER BY strategy

content.text:
In the OMOP EHR query, **triple conventional DMARDs** had the lower observed 90-day flare proportion:

| Strategy | Patients | 90-day flares | 90-day flare proportion |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Biologic + methotrexate | 1,015 | 10 | 0.0099 |
| Triple conventional DMARDs | 112 | 0 | 0.0000 |

So, in this dataset/phenotype, **triple therapy showed fewer coded 90-day RA flares** than biologic + methotrexate. The difference is small in absolute terms and the triple-therapy group is much smaller, so this should be interpreted cautiously rather than as causal superiority.

Possible immune-pathway explanation:

- **Biologic + methotrexate** often targets a dominant inflammatory axis, e.g. TNF, IL-6 receptor, CTLA4/CD80-CD86 costimulation, CD20 B cells, or IL-1, plus methotrexate’s broad anti-inflammatory effects.
- **Triple conventional DMARD therapy** — methotrexate + sulfasalazine + hydroxychloroquine — may suppress inflammation more broadly across innate immune activation, antigen presentation/TLR signaling, lymphocyte proliferation, prostaglandin/leukotriene pathways, and downstream cytokine production.
- In aggressive RA, a broader multi-pathway conventional regimen could reduce short-term flare coding if disease activity is driven by heterogeneous inflammatory circuits rather than one biologic-targeted axis.

Caveats: this is an observational EHR comparison using coded “flare of rheumatoid arthritis,” not a randomized outcome; confounding by indication, prescribing sequence, disease severity, biologic selection, and under-coding of flares may affect the result.
